correctness.rationale: The edge incidence map sends real Lip_0(P) isometrically into the nine-dimensional gradient subspace C of l_infinity^15. Hahn-Banach injectivity of l_infinity^15 identifies its relative and absolute projection constants. Averaging an arbitrary projection under the signed edge S5 representation preserves the retraction and does not increase norm. For one edge the stabilizer has order 8; its 15-coordinate signed row constraints have rank 12, leaving three signed orbit coefficients a,b,c with a+2b=1 and b=2c. Edge transitivity/trace gives 15a=9, so a=3/5,b=1/5,c=1/10 and row l1 norm 11/5. The Hodge projector B (B^TB)^dagger B^T attains this norm. Independent exact signed-stabilizer rank=12; numerical reconstructed incidence B rank=9, Hodge idempotency error <7e-16, row support 1x.6,4x.2,8x.1 and 2 zeros. Equivariant uniqueness only, not uniqueness of every norm-minimizer.
